definitions.explanation: A physical sensation, especially of comfort or discomfort.
One's underlying sentiment or the feeling behind an action.

notes:
Very common word covering emotions, physical sensations, and intentions.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {気持|きも}ち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧ (feels good, comfortable)
- {気持|きも}ち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧ (feels bad, uncomfortable, creepy)
- {気持|きも}ち⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{伝|つた}える→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧ (convey one's feelings)
- {気持|きも}ち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{分|わ}かる→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧ (understand someone's feelings)
- お{気持|きも}ち⟦だけ→だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ (just the thought [is enough])

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{気分|きぶん}→気分：01306_kibun⟧ - mood, feeling (more about general state)
- ⟦{感情|かんじょう}→感情：00171_kanjou⟧ - emotion (more formal/psychological)
- ⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧ - heart, mind (deeper)
